title: BeginGraphReplace
description: Marker that opens a 'replace this whole named graph' bracket. The Virtuoso sink interprets the bracket as PUT semantics; the Neo4j sink turns it into 'delete-all-with-label-then-merge'. Sinks track open brackets per graph_iri so a misplaced End is a hard error rather than silent corruption.

graph_iri.description: Target named graph in Virtuoso. Same string is the partitioning key for the Neo4j sink's bulk-delete clause.

label.description: Neo4j node label that the bracket replaces. Used by the Neo4j sink to scope the bulk delete; ignored by the Virtuoso sink.

domain.description: Logical domain ('sanctions', 'cpv', 'authority', etc.). Used by sink batching + observability labels.
